title: Evaluating AI performance in infectious disease education: a comparative analysis of ChatGPT, Google Bard, Perplexity AI, Microsoft Copilot, and Meta AI

live_model.evidence: "Microsoft Copilot (powered by GPT-4 Turbo)" - named only as Copilot's backend; comparison is of consumer products (ChatGPT 3.5, Bard/Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Meta AI).

claim.metric: numerical accuracy of 'Copilot' (backend nominally GPT-4 Turbo)

notes: Consumer chat-interface comparison (ChatGPT 3.5 scored highest at 65.6% numerical accuracy); no API/version/date control for any tool.
